cases.request:
Identify formulaic wording and unsupported claims in this paragraph. Quote brief examples and explain the issues without rewriting it or guessing who wrote it.

At the heart of this pivotal transformation is an unparalleled platform. Experts agree it will revolutionize every workflow.
cases.output:
“At the heart of” is a stock opening; “pivotal transformation” inflates importance without identifying what changes or why it matters.

“Unparalleled platform” claims superiority without naming competitors, comparison criteria, or evidence.

“Experts agree” invokes authority without identifying experts or citing support for consensus.

“Will revolutionize every workflow” combines vague promotional language with an absolute prediction. The paragraph provides no evidence for certainty or universal scope.
cases.output_review: Author review: identifies wording and evidence issues without rewriting or inferring authorship.
